scope: Chases the KickClientOrderEventReceiver slot-2 actor[+0x5C] readiness gate flagged as the follow-up. Result: +0x5C is a standardized 'LuaActorImpl installed / Lua-bound' flag on LuaControl-derived objects. Writer = FUN_00766F00 (BCS-Y-0135) during the per-frame Lua tick, gated on the actor-list owner's state 0x16C==10; zero-init by ActorBase ctor (BCS-Y-1710); consumed as a readiness gate by the Kick receiver, the preWarp/postWarp gates, the event-start bridge, and chat-render. Client-architecture 'Zone-in actor bind and Lua-class-readiness pipeline' added. Live decomp via the port-8081 GhidraMCP bridge.

Decompiled it: the +0x5C gate appears twice - the receiver resolves the target via FUN_00CC7A50 and short-circuits if actor+0x5C==0.

method.step_c: Catalog search surfaced the writer: FUN_00766F00 (BCS-Y-0135 actorListInstaller) sets *(actor+0x5C)=1 + installs the LuaActorImpl (FUN_00574830 BCS-Y-0134) per actor; ActorBase ctor (BCS-Y-1710) zero-inits +0x5C. Decompiled FUN_00766F00 to confirm: the pass is gated on owner state 0x16C==10.
method.step_d: get_xrefs_to chained the trigger: FUN_00766F00 <- FUN_00578970 (BCS-Y-1701 LuaFrameTick) <- FUN_004DA680 (BCS-Y-1711 Application_FrameTick). So +0x5C flips during the per-frame tick once the actor-list reaches the zone-loaded state - not via a spawn-burst packet handler.

key_findings: **+0x5C = 'LuaActorImpl installed / Lua-bound' flag** on LuaControl-derived objects (actors AND UI widgets). Zero-init by ActorBase ctor; set to 1 by the actor-list install pass FUN_00766F00 (BCS-Y-0135) which also installs the LuaActorImpl. Standardized across the 11 LTC/LGTC-derived classes (slot-12 getter BCS-Y-1557).

**Set during the per-frame Lua tick, gated on actor-list owner state 0x16C==10** ('zone-loaded/spawn-ready'). Trigger chain FUN_004DA680 (BCS-Y-1711) -> FUN_00578970 (BCS-Y-1701) -> FUN_00766F00 (BCS-Y-0135). NOT a direct spawn-burst packet write.

**Consumed as a readiness gate** by the Kick receiver (BCS-Y-0724; short-circuits if actor+0x5C==0), the preWarp engine gate (BCS-Y-1789; DesktopWidget+0x5C), ActorDirectorEventStartBridge (BCS-Y-0433), ChatRender (BCS-Y-1100), and the LuaControl finalize wrapper (BCS-Y-1576). Same field the warp/dismiss gates check.

**Blocker lead (second, affirmative readiness layer)**: unlike SharedWork (client-architecture 's2c state-push receivers do not gate on Group::SharedWork', not a gate), +0x5C IS a real gate on the Lua-callback surface that produces the loading-screen dismiss (_onPreWarp/_onPostWarp -> _fadeOut). It only flips when the install pass sees the owning actor-list at state 0x16C==10. So the productive next lead is: what advances the actor-list owner's +0x16C state to 10? That state machine is the join point between the spawn-burst (client-architecture 'Zone-in actor bind and Lua-class-readiness pipeline') and the Lua dismiss cascade.
